caseStudies.title: Consumer vehicle loan origination
caseStudies.summary: Vehicle loans from application to payout, built as .NET microservices.
caseStudies.problem: One system for applications, document checks, credit rules, decision and payout.
did: Led the team and planned sprints
Added OCR and Gemini document checks

caseStudies.title: Bank statement extraction pipeline
caseStudies.summary: Turns bank statement PDFs into clean transactions with Gemini.
caseStudies.problem: Credit teams typed transactions from bank statements by hand.
did: Built per-bank extractors with Gemini as a fallback
Fixed sign, digit and batching errors
Added validation, de-duplication and Excel export

caseStudies.title: Legacy .NET MVC modernisation
caseStudies.summary: Replaced paid DevExpress controls with AG Grid, ApexCharts and Bootstrap 5.
caseStudies.problem: An older MVC app depended on paid controls that were hard to update.
did: Swapped every control, keeping all business logic
Moved charts to ApexCharts and grids to AG Grid
